WELCOME, ALCHEMIST

Pour a little magic.

Clear the enchanted reservoir by collecting its colorful drops into matching bottles.

  1. Choose a front bottle from any cellar lane. It moves to one of five shelf slots.
  2. Watch it fill. Matching drops flow from the bottom of the reservoir. Each bottle collects three drops.
  3. Keep space for magic. Full bottles leave the shelf. If all five slots get stuck, try again.

The next bottle in each lane is revealed when you take the one in front. Look at the bottom drops before you choose.
